description: This file contains data models for managing usage events, training examples, model metadata, schedule slots, and shutdown recommendations in a system that monitors and predicts cloud instance usage, utilizing Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: UsageEvent
classes.description: Represents an event of user activity within a specific time window, with start and end times, for tracking cloud instance usage.

classes.name: TrainingExample
classes.description: Encapsulates a labeled feature set for a specific time slot of user-instance activity, used for training predictive models.

classes.name: ModelMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata related to trained models, including version, training time, feature names, and other model parameters.

classes.name: ScheduleSlot
classes.description: Represents a recommended hour-of-week slot with an associated probability of usage.

classes.name: ShutdownRecommendation
classes.description: Contains a suggested schedule for shutting down instances based on predicted usage probabilities, including threshold and hours to shutdown.

methods.name: int hour_of_week_from_dt(dt: datetime)
methods.description: Converts a UTC datetime object to an hour-of-week index (0-167), with Monday at index 0.
